info.title: Freebox Server OS API
info.description:
REST JSON API served over HTTPS by the Freebox Server (Freebox OS).

## Base URL

`https://{api_domain}:{https_port}{api_base_url}v{major_version}/...` (current major version = **4**, API version 4.0, so paths look like `/api/v4/...`).
Local access: `https://mafreebox.freebox.fr/api/v4/...`; remote access example: `https://xxxx.fbxos.fr:3615/api/v4/...`.

## Discovery

The Freebox advertises its API through the mDNS `_fbx-api._tcp` TXT record, or via `GET https://mafreebox.freebox.fr/api_version`, which returns the fields: `uid`, `device_name`, `api_version`, `api_base_url`, `device_type`, `api_domain`, `https_available`, `https_port`.

## Authentication flow

1. `POST /login/authorize/` with the app info → returns `app_token` and `track_id`.
2. Poll `GET /login/authorize/{track_id}` until `status` is `granted` (the response also carries the `challenge`).
3. `GET /login/` to retrieve the current `challenge`.
4. `POST /login/session/` with `password = HMAC-SHA1(app_token, challenge)` → returns the `session_token`.
5. Send the header `X-Fbx-App-Auth: <session_token>` on every subsequent API call.

## Response envelope

Every HTTP response is an `APIResponse` envelope: `{ "success": bool, "result"?: ..., "error_code"?: string, "msg"?: string }`.
The HTTP status code also carries error information: `403` = invalid credentials, `404` = invalid path.

## HTTPS

Since API v4, HTTPS is mandatory (unsecure HTTP access is deprecated) and the server certificate must be validated against the Freebox Root CA / Freebox ECC Root CA.

## WebSocket API

A bidirectional WebSocket API is available at `/ws/` using the same `X-Fbx-App-Auth` header. Messages are UTF-8 JSON text frames with a maximum frame size of 1 MB. Message shapes: `WebSocketRequest` / `WebSocketResponse` / `WebSocketNotification` (see `components.schemas`). File upload uses the WebSocket endpoint `/ws/upload`.

## Stability

Operations with `x-unstable: true` may change or disappear at any time. Operations with `deprecated: true` are deprecated (see their description for the replacement).

Creates the ContactNumber. The same call works for address, url and email entries (body is ContactAddress, ContactUrl or ContactEmail respectively).

## Example request
```http
POST /api/v4/number/ HTTP/1.1
Host: mafreebox.freebox.fr

{
   "contact_id":9,
   "number":"0144456789",
   "type":"fixed"
}
```

```json
    "success": true,
    "result": {
        "number": "0144456789",
        "type": "fixed",
        "id": 18,
        "contact_id": 9,
        "is_default": false,
        "is_own": false
    }
}
```

post.description:
Once you have selected an available AirMediaReceiver you can start interacting with it by sending media with this API. The request body is an AirMediaReceiverRequest: action (start/stop), media_type (photo/video), optional password, optional video start position (percent * 1000), and media (URL for video, base64 fs path for photo). Example: display a photo on the Freebox Player, play a video on the Freebox Player, or stop the current AirMedia video.

## Example request
```http
POST /api/v4/airmedia/receivers/Freebox%20Player/ HTTP/1.1
Host: mafreebox.freebox.fr

{
   "action": "start",
   "media_type": "photo",
   "media": "L0Rpc3F1ZSBkdXIvUGhvdG9zL1JvY2tldHMvRFNDXzM0OTEuanBn",
   "password": "1111"
}
```

## Example response
```json
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8

{
    "success": true
}
```

password.description: If not empty, the client will have to enter a password to be able to use this airmedia server

AirMediaReceiver.description: AirMedia receivers have the following attributes

password_protected.description: Is set to true the receiver is protected by a password

capabilities.description: List of receiver capabilities from the following list, as a boolean map: photo = can display photos, audio = can play audio files, video = can play video files, screen = can display remote screen

AirMediaReceiverRequest.description: AirMedia receiver request sent when interacting with an AirMedia receiver

action.description: Action to perform: start = start playing a media, stop = stop playing a media

media_type.description: Media type: photo = display a photo, video = display a video

position.description: Start position for a video. The start position is expressed in percent * 1000, for instance 50000 means 50% of the video

media.description: The media to play. For video media, specify the media URL (e.g. http://anon.nasa-global.edgesuite.net/HD_downloads/GRAIL_launch_480.mov). For photo media, specify the file path on the Freebox Server (base64 encoded as returned in fs/ls call), e.g. L0Rpc3F1ZSBkdXIvUGhvdG9zL1JvY2tldHMvRFNDXzM0OTEuanBn

ApiVersionInfo.description: Discovery info returned by GET /api_version and the mDNS TXT record

CallEntry.description: Call entries have the following properties

type.description: The valid call types are: missed = Missed incoming call, accepted = Incoming call, outgoing = Outgoing call

number.description: Callee number for outgoing calls. Caller number for incoming calls.

name.description: Callee name for outgoing calls. Caller name for incoming calls. For incoming call if the network does not provide a contact name, we try to use the contact database to find a suitable name

new.description: Call entry as not been acknowledged yet.

contact_id.description: If the number matches an entry in the contact database, the id of the matching contact.

ping.description: should the Freebox respond to external ping requests

is_secure_pass.description: is the admin password secure enough to enable remote access

remote_access_port.description: port number to use for remote HTTP access

remote_access_min_port.description: minimum possible value for remote_access_port (see ConnectionStatus ipv4_port_range)

remote_access_max_port.description: maximum possible value for remote_access_port (see ConnectionStatus ipv4_port_range)

remote_access_ip.description: IPv4 to use for remote access (can be missing if connection is down)

api_remote_access.description: is remote access enabled for apps, or share link

adblock_not_set.description: if set to true adblock setting has never been set by the user

allow_token_request.description: if false, user has disabled new token request. New apps can't request a new token. Apps that already have a token are still allowed

next_hop.description: the next hop for the prefix

type.description: Connection type (ethernet: FTTH, rfc2684: xDSL unbundled, pppoatm: xDSL)

ipv4.description: Freebox IPv4 address. NOTE: this field is only available when connection state is up

ipv6.description: Freebox IPv6 address. NOTE: this field is only available when connection state is up

bytes_up.description: total uploaded bytes since last connection

bytes_down.description: total downloaded bytes since last connection

ipv4_port_range.description: Some customers share the same IPv4 and each customer is then assigned a port range. The first value is the first port of the assigned range and the second value is the last port (inclusive). All PortForwardingConfig must use ports in this range to be effective.

x-freebox-changelog: 3.0->4.0 [added-field]: New attribute: ipv4_port_range, exposed for customers that don't have a 'full' IPv4.

ContactAddress.description: Contact address have the following properties

type.description: Type of address: home = home address, work = work address, other = other

ContactEmail.description: Contact email have the following properties

type.description: Type of email: home = home address, work = work address, other = other

ContactEntry.description: Contact entries have the following properties

photo_url.description: contact photo URL. NOTE: the photo URL can be embedded (for instance "data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AA [ ... ]")

ContactNumber.description: Contact number have the following properties

type.description: Type of number: fixed = fixed phone, mobile = mobile phone, work = work, fax = fax, other = other

is_default.description: is this number the preferred contact phone number

is_own.description: is this number the Freebox owner number

ContactUrl.description: Contact URL have the following properties

type.description: Type of URL: profile = profile address, blog = blog address, site = website address, other = other

hostname.description: dns name to use to register

status.description: DDNS status (disabled: Disabled, ok: Ok, wait: Updating, reqfail: Request failed, authfail: Authentication error, nocredential: Invalid credential, ipinval: Invalid IP, hostinval: Invalid hostname, abuse: Blocked because of abuse, dnserror: DNS error, unavailable: Service unavailable, nowan: Unable to get wan IP, unknown: Unknown)

DhcpConfig.description: DHCP config has the following attributes

sticky_assign.description: Always assign the same IP to a given host

dns.description: List of dns servers to include in DHCP reply

DhcpDynamicLease.description: DHCP dynamic lease have the following attributes

lease_remaining.description: time left before lease needs to be refreshed

assign_time.description: timestamp of the lease first assignment

refresh_time.description: timestamp of the last lease refresh

host.description: LAN host information from LAN browser (refer to LanHost documentation)

DhcpStaticLease.description: DHCP static lease have the following attributes

ip.description: IPv4 to assign to the host

host.description: LAN host information from LAN browser (refer to LanHost documentation)

enabled_ipv6.description: is the dht enabled on IPv6

node_count_ipv6.description: number of active nodes on IPv6

path.description: partition mount point (encoded in base64 as explained in fs API)

sources.description: list of block list URL source. The block list should be in cidr format, e.g.: http://list.iblocklist.com/?list=bt_level1&fileformat=cidr&archiveformat=

max_peers.description: maximum number of peers at a given time

stop_ratio.description: default stop_ratio for bt Download tasks. This value is scaled by a factor 100, for instance a stop_ratio of 200 means that the task will stop once tx_bytes = 2 * size. A value of 0 means that the task will continue seeding until it is manually stopped

crypto_support.description: The crypto_support can have the following values: unsupported (will never use bittorrent crypto), allowed (will select plain during handshake), preferred (will select crypto during handshake), required (will allow plain bittorrent)

announce_timeout.description: timeout in seconds for announcing to tracker

fetch_interval.description: interval between automatic RSS refresh (in minutes)

ssl.description: Use SSL to connect to server if set to true

user.description: NNTP auth username (can be empty if no auth is required)

password.description: NNTP auth password (can be empty if no auth is required)

nthreads.description: maximum concurrent connections to the NNTP server

auto_repair.description: automatically check and repair downloaded files using the provided par2 files

lazy_par2.description: if set to true the downloader will download the par2 files only if the download is corrupted

auto_extract.description: automatically attempt to extract downloaded files

erase_tmp.description: if auto_extract is enabled, delete archive files once successfully extracted

tx_rate.description: maximum transmit rate (in byte/s). 0 means no limit

rx_rate.description: maximum receive rate (in byte/s). 0 means no limit

normal.description: download rate for normal time slot (in B/s)

slow.description: download rate for normal slow slot (in B/s)

schedule.description: The schedule array represent the list of week hours timeslot, starting on monday a midnight. Therefore the complete week is represented in a array of 168 elements (24 * 7). Each slot can have the following value: normal (downloads will use normal DlRate config for this timeslot), slow (downloads will use slow DlRate config for this timeslot), hibernate (downloads will be paused for this timeslot)

mode.description: Throttling mode can have to following values: normal (force use of normal rate limits, not using the scheduler), slow (force use of slow rate limits, not using the scheduler), hibernate (force hibernate, not using the scheduler), schedule (use scheduded rate limit)

DmzConfig.description: Dmz config has the following attributes:

Download.description: Download objects have the following attributes:

type.description: The valid download types are: bt (bittorrent download), nzb (newsgroup download), http (HTTP download), ftp (FTP download)

status.description: The valid download status are: stopped (task is stopped, can be resumed by setting the status to downloading), queued (task will start when a new download slot is available, the queue position is stored in queue_pos attribute), starting (task is preparing to start download), downloading, stopping (task is gracefully stopping), error (there was a problem with the download, you can get an error code in the error field), done (the download is over. For bt you can resume seeding setting the status to seeding if the ratio is not reached yet), checking (only valid for nzb: download is over, the downloaded files are being checked using par2), repairing (only valid for nzb: download is over, the downloaded files are being repaired using par2), extracting (only valid for nzb: download is over, the downloaded files are being extracted), seeding (only valid for bt: download is over, the content is being shared to other users. The task will automatically stop once the seed ratio has been reached), retry (You can set a task status to 'retry' to restart the download task.)

queue_pos.description: position in download queue (0 if not queued)

io_priority.description: The valid download priorities are: low, normal, high

tx_pct.description: transmit percentage (without protocol overhead). To improve precision the value has been scaled by 100 so that a tx_pct of 123 means 1.23%

rx_pct.description: received percentage (without protocol overhead). To improve precision the value has been scaled by 100 so that a rx_pct of 123 means 1.23%

error.description: An error code (see 'Download Task / TaskFile Errors' table: none, internal, disk_full, unknown, parse_error, http_3xx/http_4xx/http_5xx, nzb_*, unknown_host, timeout, bad_authentication, connection_refused, bt_tracker_error, bt_missing_files, bt_file_error, missing_ctx_file, ...)

created_ts.description: timestamp of the download creation time

download_dir.description: directory where the file(s) will be saved (base64 encoded)

stop_ratio.description: Only relevant for bittorrent tasks. Once the transmit ratio has been reached the task will stop seeding. The ratio is scaled by 100 to improve resolution. A stop_ratio of 150 means that the task will stop seeding once tx_bytes = 1.5 * rx_bytes.

archive_password.description: (**only relevant for nzb**) password for extracting downloaded archives

info_hash.description: (**only relevant for bt**) torrent info_hash encoded in hexa

piece_length.description: (**only relevant for bt**) torrent piece length in bytes

x-freebox-changelog: 1.1->2.0 [changed]: New 'cookies' parameter when adding a download by URL, so browser plugins can pass cookies along with the URL (useful for session-based authentication).
3.0->4.0 [added-field]: New attributes: info_hash, piece_length (for bittorrent downloads).

DownloadBlacklistEntry.description: Each DownloadBlacklistEntry can be specific to a torrent, or "global" and apply to any torrent. [UNSTABLE]

reason.description: blacklist reason. Doc table lists: disconnected, connecting, handshaking, ready (apparently a copy-paste of peer states); example responses show reasons such as torrent_not_found, conn_closed, timeout, user

global.description: does this entry applies to all torrents

download_dir.description: the default path where downloads will be stored (base64 encoded)

watch_dir.description: special folder that will be monitored. When a new supported file (.nzb, .torrent) is copied in that folder, the task is automatically added to the download queue. (base64 encoded)

use_watch_dir.description: if set to false, the watch_dir will not be monitored

dns1.description: dns server ip to use for downloader (leave blank for default dns server)

dns2.description: dns server ip to use for downloader

DownloadFeed.description: Download Feeds have the following attributes:

status.description: The feed can have the following status

image_url.description: Feed image URL (extracted from the RSS)

nb_read.description: Number of read items in the feed

nb_unread.description: Number of unread items in the feed

auto_download.description: If set to true, the downloader will automatically download new items

fetch_ts.description: Last time the feed was fetched

pub_ts.description: Last time the feed was published on remote server

error.description: Error code (same as used in Download or DownloadFile).

DownloadFeedItem.description: Each RSS DownloadFeed contains feed items object

link.description: URL of the RSS feed attachment

is_read.description: you can mark the item as read manually, or it is marked as read automatically when the item is downloaded

is_downloaded.description: mark downloaded items, automatically set to true when RSS item is downloaded

enclosure_url.description: enclosure URL (if specified in RSS feed)

enclosure_type.description: enclosure mime type (if specified in RSS feed)

enclosure_length.description: enclosure size in bytes (if specified in RSS feed)

DownloadFile.description: Each Download has one or more DownloadFile.

filepath.description: full filepath on the disk (encoded as in file system api)

status.description: file download status: queued (file is queued for download), error (there was a problem with this file, see error to get the error code), done (file download is completed)

error.description: file error code in case status is error (see 'Download Task / TaskFile Errors' table)

priority.description: file download priority inside the download task: no_dl (this file will not be downloaded), low (low priority), normal (default priority), high (high priority)

preview_url.description: url to preview downloaded file (only available for bittorrent) as a share link, this url can be used without requiring any form of authentication so that it can be passed as-is to any software.

x-freebox-changelog: 1.1->2.0 [added-field]: New attributes: filepath, name, mimetype (added alongside the deprecated 'path' attribute).

DownloadPeer.description: Each torrent Download task has one or more DownloadPeer. [UNSTABLE]

state.description: peer state: disconnected (not connected), connecting (trying to connect to the peer), handshaking (connected to the peer, negotiating capabilities), ready (ready to exchange data)

origin.description: peer origin: tracker (got the peer from the tracker), incoming (incoming peer), dht (got the peer from DHT), pex (got the peer from Peer exchange protocol), user (manually added peer)

country_code.description: Peer country code (iso 3166). If country code is not available it will have the value "??"

DownloadStats.description: Download Stats object - synthetic information about the downloader

nb_tasks_active.description: number of active tasks (checking + queued + extracting + repairing + seeding + downloading)

rx_rate.description: current receive rate in bytes / second

tx_rate.description: current transmit rate in bytes / second

throttling_mode.description: active throttling_mode (see DlThrottlingConfig, defined on the download_config page: #/components/schemas/DlThrottlingConfig)

throttling_is_scheduled.description: if true, the current throttling mode has been computed using the throttling schedule; if false, the current throttling mode has been manually forced

x-freebox-changelog: 1.1->2.0 [added-field]: New attributes: conn_ready, nb_peer, blocklist_entries, blocklist_hits, dht_stats.

DownloadTracker.description: Each torrent Download task has one or more DownloadTracker. Each tracker is identified by its announce URL. [UNSTABLE]

is_backup.description: true if the tracker is a backup tracker (the downloader won't connect to this tracker unless the primary tracker fails)

status.description: tracker status: unannounced (not announced), announcing, announce_failed (an error occurred while trying to announce), announced

interval.description: desired interval between two announces (in seconds)

min_interval.description: minimum interval between two announces (in seconds)

nseeders.description: number of seeders announced on tracker

nleechers.description: number of leechers announced on tracker

path.description: file path (encoded in base64 as explained in Path Encoding)

target.description: symlink target path (encoded in base64 as explained in Path Encoding) (only present when link is set to true)

hidden.description: should the file be hidden to user

foldercount.description: number of subfolders, only relevant for dir, only provided if "countSubFolder" parameter is set

filecount.description: number of files inside directory, only relevant for dir, only provided if "countSubFolder" parameter is set

FileUpload.description: File upload object. File uploads have the following attributes:

status.description: upload status can have the following values

last_update.description: last update of file upload object

FileUploadCancelAction.description: File Upload Cancel action (WebSocket message, action 'upload_cancel')

FileUploadChunkResponse.description: File Upload Chunk Response (WebSocket message, action 'upload_data', sent for each received chunk; request_id is the one from the FileUploadStartAction)

complete.description: will be true in a reply to FileUploadFinalizeAction or FileUploadCancelAction

cancelled.description: will be true in a reply to FileUploadCancelAction

FileUploadFinalizeAction.description: File Upload Finalize action (WebSocket message, action 'upload_finalize')

FileUploadStartAction.description: File Upload Start Action (WebSocket message, action 'upload_start')

force.description: select the way conflicts are handled

Frecord.description: Frecord (Finished record): a record that is finished or in progress. A Frecord object is created automatically when a Precord start time is reached.

media.description: media name on which the record is written (see the Media API for more info). This property can be empty when the file backing the record is not available, for example when secure is set.

path.description: destination directory on the media storage

byte_size.description: size of the record file in bytes

has_record_gen.description: if true, this frecord has been generated using a Generator

record_gen_id.description: if has_record_gen, this is the id of the generator

altered.description: a frecord is altered when some part of the recording may be missing. This can be the case if a conflict occurred during the recording (or connection was down)

channel_type.description: channel type: '' (empty string) = auto, iptv = use only iptv streams, dvb = use only dvb streams

secure.description: flag set when the record is protected by DRM

local.description: if true the Freeplug is connected directly to the Freebox

rx_rate.description: rx rate (from the freeplugs to the "cco" freeplug) (in Mb/s) -1 if not available

tx_rate.description: tx rate (from the "cco" freeplug to the freeplugs) (in Mb/s) -1 if not available

members.description: List of freeplugs member of this network

FsTask.description: File system tasks have the following attributes:

type.description: The valid task types are: cat (Concatenate multiple files), cp (Copy files), mv (Move files), rm (Remove files), archive (Creates an archive), extract (Extract an archive), repair (Check and repair files)

state.description: queued (only one task is active at a given time), running, paused (user suspended), done, failed (see error)

eta.description: estimated time remaining before the task completion (in seconds)

curr_bytes.description: size of the file currently processed

curr_bytes_done.description: number of bytes processed for the current file

allow_remote_access.description: enable ftp server remote access. NOTE: to be able to enable the remote access the password must be strong enough

weak_password.description: is the ftp password weak (in this case remote access is disabled)

port_ctrl.description: ftp control port to use for remote access

port_data.description: ftp data port to use for remote access

remote_domain.description: domain name to use for remote access

IncomingPortConfig.description: Incoming port config has the following attributes. NOTE: you can't add or remove incoming ports, these ports are managed by Freebox services. In case of conflict with a nat port forwarding rule, this rule will have a higher priority and override the port forwarding rule.

id.description: incoming port id (http: http port for remote access to Freebox OS, https: https port for tls remote access to Freebox OS, bittorrent-main: main bittorrent port for Freebox downloader, bittorrent-dht: bittorrent port for DHT, openvpn_routed: routed openvpn port, openvpn_bridge: bridged openvpn port, ipsec_ike: ipsec ikev2 vpn port, ipsec_nat: ipsec nat vpn port, pptp: pptp vpn server port, ftp: ftp control port for FTP remote access, ftp_pasv: ftp data port for FTP remote access)

active.description: is the port binding currently active

type.description: IP protocol (tcp: TCP, udp: UDP, tcp_udp: both TCP and UDP)

netns.description: network namespace. The service may be running on a different namespace (for instance if the service uses the vpn client).

min_port.description: This field indicate the minimum possible value for in_port (see: ConnectionStatus ipv4_port_range)

max_port.description: This field indicate the maximum possible value for in_port (see: ConnectionStatus ipv4_port_range)

readonly.description: If set to true, the in_port field cannot be changed because of the underlying protocol does not allow it

LanConfig.description: Lan config object. Lan config has the following attributes:

type.description: The valid LAN modes are: router (The Freebox acts as a network router), bridge (The Freebox acts as a network bridge). NOTE: in bridge mode, most of Freebox services are disabled. It is recommended to use the router mode, and third party apps should not change this setting

LanHost.description: Lan Host object. Lan Host has the following attributes:

primary_name.description: Host primary name (chosen from the list of available names, or manually set by user)

host_type.description: When possible, the Freebox will try to guess the host_type, but you can manually override this to the correct value

primary_name_manual.description: If true the primary name has been set manually

l2ident.description: Layer 2 network id and its type

vendor_name.description: Host vendor name (from the mac address)

persistent.description: If true the host is always shown even if it has not been active since the Freebox startup

reachable.description: If true the host can receive traffic from the Freebox

last_time_reachable.description: Last time the host was reached

active.description: If true the host sends traffic to the Freebox

last_activity.description: Last time the host sent traffic

names.description: List of available names, and their source

l3connectivities.description: List of available layer 3 network connections

type.description: Type of layer 2 address. Known values: dhcp (DHCP), netbios (Netbios), mdns (mDNS), upnp (UPnP); examples also show mac_address

Media.description: Media object: represents a storage on which records can be written to, typically a disk

free_bytes.description: number of free bytes on the medium

total_bytes.description: total number of bytes on the medium

record_time.description: estimated record time in seconds for multiple channel types and qualities (per channel type dvb/iptv and quality ld/sd/hd/3d)

status.description: The valid config status are: not_checked (config has not been checked yet), checking (test in progress), error (config is invalid, see error), ok (config is ok)

error.description: The valid config errors are: none (test is ok), nzb_authentication_required (authentication is required), bad_authentication (incorrect credentials), connection_refused (unable to connect to NNTP server)

macs.description: the list of mac addresses the rule should be applied to

hosts.description: the list of hostnames associated with macs

ip.description: only filled for old rules, you cannot set a rule with an IP

forced.description: if set to true, the rule will not use the planning and will always stay in the forced_mode

forced_mode.description: the filter policy to use when forced is set to true (see filter_state for valid states)

tmp_mode_expire.description: if != 0 the rule will not use the planning for the next tmp_mode_expire seconds

tmp_mode.description: the filter policy to use when tmp_mode_expire is != 0 (see filter_state for valid states)

scheduling_mode.description: current scheduling mode: forced (filter_state is forced to forced_mode), temporary (filter_state is temporary set to tmp_mode for the next tmp_mode_expire seconds), planning (filter_state is set using the planning)

filter_state.description: current filter state: allowed (access is allowed), denied (access is denied), webonly (access is granted only for HTTP and HTTPS traffic)

current_mapping_idx.description: current index used in planning to compute filter_state (only relevant when scheduling_mode is planning)

next_change.description: seconds until next filter_state change, 0 means filter_state won't change

ParentalFilterConfig.description: Parental filter configuration allows you to set the default filter_state to apply to hosts without rules on your network

default_filter_mode.description: default filter_state for hosts without rules (see available filter_state)

ParentalFilterPlanning.description: Parental filter planning lets you define the parental filter policy based on the week day and the hour

resolution.description: planning resolution: number of planning slots per day, e.g. 48 means that each slot represent 30 minutes

cdayranges.description: list of custom day range, each custom day range represents a group of days for which you want to use a different planning than other week days (e.g. children holidays). Each cdayranges can be a coma separated list of cdayranges, for instance ":fr_bank_holidays,:fr_school_holidays_b"

mapping.description: array of states for each corresponding planning slots. The array size is: (number of cdayranges + 7) * resolution

PortForwardingConfig.description: Port forwarding config has the following attributes:

lan_port.description: forwarding target start port on LAN, (last port is lan_port + wan_port_end - wan_port_start)

src_ip.description: if src_ip == 0.0.0.0 this rule will apply to any src ip otherwise it will only apply to the specified ip address

Precord.description: Precord (Programmed record): a planned record. Precords can be manual, or generated using a PVR Generator. Only manual Precords can be edited directly.

media.description: media name on which the record will be written to (see the Media API for more info). This property can be empty when the file backing the record is not available, for example when secure is set.

path.description: destination directory on the media storage where the record will be written to

has_record_gen.description: if true, this precord has been generated using a Generator

record_gen_id.description: if has_record_gen, this is the id of the generator

conflict.description: if true this record may conflict with another record

overlap_list.description: in case of conflict, this will contain the list of records id that may conflict with this record

enabled.description: it only applies to generated records. If false the generated precord will be skipped.

altered.description: a precord is altered when some part of the recording may be missing. This can be the case if a conflict occurred during the recording (or connection was down)

channel_type.description: channel type: '' (empty string) = auto, iptv = use only iptv streams, dvb = use only dvb streams

legacy_uri.description: only used for legacy apps. Use channel_uuid instead when available. NOTE: only visible when called from player

force_channel_name.description: only used for legacy apps. Use channel_uuid instead when available. NOTE: only visible when called from player

margin_before.description: default margin before recording start time

margin_after.description: default margin after recording end time

RRDFetch.description: This is the object used to get stats

db.description: Name of the rrd database to read: net = network stats, temp = temperature stats, dsl = xDSL stats, switch = switch stats

date_start.description: The requested start timestamp of the stats to get. NOTE: this can be adjusted to fit the best available resolution

date_end.description: The requested end timestamp of the stats to get. NOTE: this can be adjusted to fit the best available resolution

precision.description: By default all values are cast to int, if you need floating point precision you can provide a precision factor that will be applied to all values before being returned. For instance if you want 2 digit precision you should use a precision of 100, and divide the obtained results by 100.

fields.description: If you are only interested in getting some fields you can provide the list of fields you want to get. net db fields: bw_up (upload available bandwidth byte/s), bw_down (download available bandwidth byte/s), rate_up (upload rate byte/s), rate_down (download rate byte/s), vpn_rate_up (vpn client upload rate byte/s), vpn_rate_down (vpn client download rate byte/s). temp db fields: cpum (temperature cpum °C), cpub (temperature cpub °C), sw (temperature sw °C), hdd (temperature hdd °C), fan_speed (fan rpm), temp1/temp2/temp3 (DEPRECATED, use cpum/cpub/sw). dsl db fields: rate_up, rate_down (dsl bandwidth byte/s), snr_up, snr_down (signal/noise ratio in 1/10 dB). switch db fields: rx_1..rx_4, tx_1..tx_4 (receive/transmit rate on port 1-4 in byte/s).

logon_enabled.description: is login/password required to access shares

SessionStart.description: Object sent to POST /api/v4/login/session/ to open a session.

app_id.description: Same app_id used in TokenRequest to get the app_token

password.description: The password computed using the challenge and the app_token. To compute the password you have to compute the hmac-sha1 of the challenge and the app_token: password = hmac-sha1(app_token, challenge)

ShareLink.description: Share link object. Share links have the following attributes:

path.description: The root path of the share, if the path is a regular file, only this file will be shared

name.description: The readable name of the shared file/folder

expire.description: Link expiration timestamp, 0 means no expiration.

fullurl.description: Full URL to use for remote access. If remote access is disabled, the field will be empty.

external_pm_idle_before_spindown.description: idle time in minutes to wait before spinning down an external disk

time_before_spindown.description: seconds left before disk spin down (in seconds) (when available)

duplex.description: duplex mode (auto: auto negotiate duplex mode, half: force in half duplex mode, full: force in full duplex mode)

link.description: port link state (up: port is up, down: port is down)

duplex.description: duplex mode (half: force in half duplex mode, full: force in full duplex mode)

mode.description: display form of speed and duplex mode

mac_list.description: list of { mac, name } of hosts connected to this port

enumDescriptions.not_detected: The disk as not been detected

box_flavor.description: the box 'flavor' for a given model

enumDescriptions.full: The box has an internal storage
enumDescriptions.light: The box has no internal storage

user_main_storage.description: The label of the storage partition to use for user data. (Matches the label of the DiskPartition). In case of 'light' box flavor, it must be set by to a permanently attached external storage

TokenRequest.description: Object sent to POST /api/v4/login/authorize/ to request an app_token.

app_name.description: A descriptive application name (will be displayed on lcd)

device_name.description: The name of the device on which the app will be used

enabled.description: is the UPnP AV service enabled
is the UPnP IGD service enabled

version.description: UPnP IGD protocol version. Supported values are 1 / 2

int_ip.description: the target IP on your LAN

int_port.description: the target port on your LAN

active.description: is this configuration active. Only one configuration is active at a time.

conf_pptp.description: only available when type is PPTP

VPNClientConfigPPTP.description: VPNClientConfigPPTP has the following attributes: (declared as a second '.. json:object:: VPNClientConfig' in the source, named VPNClientConfigPPTP by its own description)

allowed_auth.description: allowed authentication methods dictionnary with following keys: eap, pap, chap, mschap, mschapv2. values are booleans.

next_try.description: seconds left until next connection attempt

IPv4.description: connection IPv4 information (returned as "ipv4" in the example response)

local_ip.description: attributed IP address from VPN adress pool

id_custom.description: value of the source id when id_source is custom

auth_modes.description: map of supported auth modes, currently only psk is supported

allowed_auth.description: allowed authentication methods dictionnary with following entries: pap, chap, mschapv2. values are booleans.

auth_connection_count.description: number of active connections that have passed authentication

enable_ipv4.description: enable IPv4 on this server. NOTE: Not relevant for openvpn_bridge, and pptp

enable_ipv6.description: enable IPv4 on this server. NOTE: Not relevant for openvpn_bridge, and pptp

port.description: the server port. NOTE: you can only edit the server port when type is openvpn

min_port.description: This field indicate the minimum possible value for port (see :json:object:`ConnectionStatus` ipv4_port_range)

max_port.description: This field indicate the maximum possible value for port (see :json:object:`ConnectionStatus` ipv4_port_range)

port_ike.description: IPSec ike server port. NOTE: only present for ipsec server

port_nat.description: IPSec nat server port. NOTE: only present for ipsec server

conf_pptp.description: only available when type is PPTP

conf_openvpn.description: only available when type is OpenVPN

conf_ipsec.description: only available when type is IPsec

ip_start.description: start of the IP range that will be used to give clients an IP

ip_end.description: end of the IP range that will be used to give clients an IP

ip6_start.description: start of the IPv6 range that will be used to give clients an IPv6

ip6_end.description: end of the IPv6 range that will be used to give clients an IPv6

password.description: VPN user password (length must be between 8 and 32)

password_set.description: True if a password was provided for this user

ip_reservation.description: You can specify the IP you want to assign to this user. If you don't want to use a specific IP pass an empty string or omit this property. The IP must be in the VPN range (see ip_start, ip_end).

event.description: name of the event that generated the notification

request_id.description: optional; if set, echoed in the corresponding response to correlate request/response

action.description: the request action (available actions described per API)

WifiAllowedComb.description: Allowed channel combination for a given AP

band.description: the band for which the combination can be used (2d4g: 2.4 GHz, 5g: 5 GHz, 60g: 60 GHz)

channel_width.description: the channel_width for which the combination can be used

need_dfs.description: does this combination requires DFS. You should only allow this combination if ap has allowed dfs.

dfs_cac_time.description: time required in dfs state before behing able to start the AP

secondary.description: secondary channel (zero means that secondary channel will not be used)

WifiApCapabilities.description: Wi-Fi AP capabilities. NOTE: before enabling some feature in ap config, you should ensure that AP supports the feature using its provided capabilities.

2d4g.description: map of capabilites in 2.4 GHz band

5g.description: map of capabilites in 5 GHz band

60g.description: map of capabilites in 60 GHz band

primary_channel.description: wanted primary channel, value of 0 means automatic selection

secondary_channel.description: wanted secondary channel, value of 0 means automatic selection

WifiBss.description: Wi-Fi BSS (each AP can manage a set of BSS)

enabled.description: enable this BSS. Note that if you want the AP to completely stop emitting wifi you should use WifiGlobalConfig enabled attribute, otherwise FreeWifi and FreeWifi Secure may still be active.

use_default_config.description: if true, share the configuration with the main bss

hide_ssid.description: don't show bss in bss list

encryption.description: encryption mode (wep: wep (should not use), wpa_psk_auto: wpa/psk auto, wpa_psk_tkip: wpa/psk tkip, wpa_psk_ccmp: wpa/psk ccmp, wpa2_psk_auto: wpa2/psk auto, wpa2_psk_tkip: wpa2/psk tkip, wpa2_psk_ccmp: wpa2/psk ccmp)

sta_count.description: number of stations for this bss

authorized_sta_count.description: number of authenticated stations for this bss

is_main_bss.description: if bss is main bss, its configuration will be reused for other bss with attribute use_default_config set as true. This can be used to apply the same configuration to 2 bss on 2 AP operating on different wifi bands.

noise_level.description: noise level on channel in dB

WifiGlobalConfig.description: Global config gives quick access to major configuration settings (eg: toggle Wi-Fi)

mac_filter_state.description: mac filter state (disabled: mac filter is disabled, whitelist: mac filter is enabled using a whitelist, blacklist: mac filter is enabled using a blacklist)

type.description: filter type (whitelist: if mac_filter is set to whitelist this station will be allowed, blacklist: if mac_filter is set to blacklist this station will be rejected)

WifiNeighbor.description: Surrounding Wi-Fi access point seen by the radar

WifiPlanning.description: Wi-Fi planning (time ranges when wifi is enabled)

resolution.description: planning resolution (number of slots per day)

mapping.description: mapping for planning: "on" or "off". mapping[0] is monday at 0:0, mapping[7 * resolution - 1] is sunday last slot (each slot has a duration of 60 * 24 / resolution minutes)

WifiStation.description: Wi-Fi station associated to an AP

bssid.description: bssid on which the client is associated

state.description: station state (associated: station is associated, authenticated: station is authenticated)

bitrate.description: physical link rate (in 1/10th of MBit/s), -1 if unknown

mcs.description: current link mcs, -1 if not used

vht_mcs.description: current link vht mcs, -1 if not used

rxmt.description: only available when phyr is on

rxmt_corr.description: only available when phyr is on

rxmt_uncorr.description: only available when phyr is on

rtx_tx.description: only available when ginp is on

rtx_c.description: only available when ginp is on

rtx_uc.description: only available when ginp is on

status.description: xDSL status (down: unsynchronized, training: synchronizing step 1/4, started: synchronizing step 2/4, chan_analysis: synchronizing step 3/4, msg_exchange: synchronizing step 4/4, showtime: Ready, disabled: Disabled)

protocol.description: xDSL protocol (t1413: T1.413, adsl1_a: ADSL, adsl2_a: ADSL2, adsl2plus_a: ADSL2+, readsl2: ReachDSL, adsl2_m: ADSL2 annex M, adsl2plus_m: ADSL2+ annex M, unknown: Unknown)
